description: One row per order.
model: ref('fct_orders')
defaults:

entities:

    type: primary
    expr: order_id
  - name: customer
    type: foreign
    expr: customer_id
dimensions:
  - name: status
    type: categorical
    description: Lifecycle status.
  - name: ordered_at
    type: time
    type_params:
      time_granularity: day
measures:
  - name: order_total
    agg: sum
    expr: order_total

      window_choice: max

# Hand-written semantic layer; this comment stays.
semantic_models:
  - name: customers
    model: ref('stg_customers')
    entities:
      - name: customer
        type: primary
        expr: id

  - name: fct_orders
    description: 'One row per order. Population: Paid and shipped orders, test accounts removed; status is one of ''paid'' or ''shipped''.'
    model: ref('fct_orders')
    defaults:
      agg_time_dimension: ordered_at
    entities:
      - name: order
        type: primary
        expr: order_id
      - name: customer
        type: foreign
        expr: customer_id
    dimensions:
      - name: status
        type: categorical
        description: Lifecycle status.
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              null_rule: never
      - name: ordered_at
        type: time
        type_params:
          time_granularity: day
    measures:
      - name: order_total
        agg: sum
        expr: order_total
        config:
          meta:
            dex:
              unit: currency:EUR
      - name: balance
        agg: sum
        expr: balance
        non_additive_dimension:
          name: ordered_at
          window_choice: max
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          population:
            rule: Paid and shipped orders, test accounts removed
            filters:
              - column: status
                includes:
                  - paid
                  - shipped
          assumptions:
            - decision: what counts as an order
              chosen: paid or shipped
              evidence: request
